annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Council of the People's Republic of China
named_instruments_referenced: 城市供水条例 (Urban Water Supply Regulations)
annotation.summary_en: State Council Decree No. 831 promulgating China's Water Supply Regulations, adopted 31 Dec 2025, effective 1 June 2026, replacing the Urban Water Supply Regulations. It governs continuity of supply, protection of supply facilities, information disclosure and penalties. It does not deal with AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Water suppliers must maintain uninterrupted supply and give 24 hours' notice before planned outages
Construction units bear the costs of relocating water facilities and must report to authorities 15 days before work starts
Fines of up to RMB 500,000 for violations affecting water supply safety
Suppliers must publicly disclose connection procedures, service standards and water quality testing
Effective 1 June 2026; repeals the Urban Water Supply Regulations
